title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — official 2023 Gazette amendment and amendment-history note

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Gazette of India
content.citation: Companies (Management and Administration) Second Amendment Rules, 2023, G.S.R. 801(E), 27 October 2023
content.note: The official Gazette notification dated 27 October 2023 amends rule 9, not rule 18. Its printed amendment-history note states that the principal 2014 Rules were last amended by G.S.R. 44(E), dated 21 January 2023. This is limited evidence of what that instrument says and of the specific operative rule-9 amendment; it is not a consolidated text of Rule 18, does not establish that no later notification affects Rule 18, and does not certify the current rule text. Continue checking the complete official Gazette chain and later instruments before relying on Rule 18.
